primary_task: Advise on whether and how to scale a Qdrant node vertically (sizing, steps, cautions) in a written answer.

requirements.name: Qdrant Cloud Console account (or qcloud CLI)
requirements.evidence: Log into [Qdrant Cloud Console](https://cloud.qdrant.io/) or use [CLI tool](https://github.com/qdrant/qcloud-cli)
requirements.basis: lacks: 'accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services' and 'other hosts are refused' (cloud.qdrant.io is not allow-listed). The qcloud CLI from GitHub is reachable but needs credentials.

requirements.name: self-hosted VM/container resize
requirements.evidence: For self-hosted deployments, resize the underlying VM or container resources
requirements.basis: lacks: 'accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services ... cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP'

requirements.name: Grafana/Prometheus monitoring
requirements.evidence: Monitor actual usage via Grafana/Prometheus before and after resizing
requirements.basis: The manifest does not say what monitoring the user's cluster exposes.

notes: I took the deliverable as guidance (decision, RAM formula, cautions), which needs only reasoning. If the request were read as 'resize my cluster', Cloud Console access is unavailable and the verdict would be BLOCKED.
